english_title: 33. His Supplication in Asking for the Best

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ
phrases.english: 1.O God, I ask from You the best in Your knowledge,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاقْضِ لِيْ بِالْخِيَرَةِ
phrases.english: 2.so bless Muhammad and his Household and decree for me the best!

phrases.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَعْرِفَةَ الاخْتِيَارِ،
phrases.english: 3.Inspire us with knowledge to chose the best

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ ذَرِيعَةً إلَى الرِّضَا
phrases.english: 4.and make that a means to being pleased

phrases.arabic: بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لَنَا وَالتَّسْلِيْمِ لِمَا حَكَمْتَ.
phrases.english: 5.with what You hast decreed for us and submitting to what You hast decided!

phrases.arabic: فَأَزِحْ عَنَّا رَيْبَ الارْتِيَابِ،
phrases.english: 6.Banish from us the doubt of misgiving

phrases.arabic: وَأَيِّدْنَا بِيَقِينِ الْمُخْلِصِينَ،
phrases.english: 7.and confirm us with the certainty of the sincere!

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَسُمْنَا عَجْزَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ عَمَّا تَخَيَّرْتَ،
phrases.english: 8.Visit us not with incapacity to know what You hast chosen,

phrases.arabic: فَنَغْمِطَ قَدْرَكَ، وَنَكْرَهَ مَوْضِعَ رِضَاكَ،
phrases.english: 9.lest we despise Your measuring out, dislike the place of Your good pleasure,

phrases.arabic: وَنَجْنَحَ إلَى الَّتِي هِيَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْعَاقِبَةِ
phrases.english: 10.and incline toward that which is further from good outcome

phrases.arabic: وَأَقْرَبُ إلَى  ضِدِّ الْعَافِيَةِ.
phrases.english: 11.and nearer to the opposite of well-being!

phrases.arabic: حَبِّبْ إلَيْنَا مَا نَكْرَهُ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ
phrases.english: 12.Make us love what we dislike in Your decree

phrases.arabic: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيْنَا مَا نَسْتَصْعِبُ مِنْ حُكْمِكَ،
phrases.english: 13.and make easy for us what we find difficult in Your decision!

phrases.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنَـا الانْقِيَـادَ لِمَا أَوْرَدْتَ عَلَيْنَـا مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ
phrases.english: 14.Inspire us to yield to that which You bringest upon us by Your will,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ نُحِبَّ تَأخِيْرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ،
phrases.english: 15.lest we love the delay of what You hast hastened

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَعْجيْلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ، وَلا نَكْرَهَ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ،
phrases.english: 16.and the hastening of what You hast delayed, dislike what You lovest,

phrases.arabic: وَلا نَتَخَيَّرَ مَا كَرِهْتَ،
phrases.english: 17.and choose what You dislikest!

phrases.arabic: وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْمَدُ عَاقِبةً وَأكْرَمُ مَصِيراً
phrases.english: 18.Seal us with that which is most praised in outcome and most generous in issue!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ تُفِيدُ الْكَرِيمَةَ وَتُعْطِي الْجَسِيمَةَ،
phrases.english: 19.Surely You givest generous gain, bestowest the immense,

phrases.arabic: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ .
phrases.english: 20.dost what You wilt, and You art "powerful over everything" (3:26).
